nextPhase.label: SHS V1 Role/Security UX Checks
nextPhase.goal: Confirm login, auth context, protected route behavior, admin-only visibility, partner/hub access, and role-based navigation behavior.
checklist: Confirm login route renders without blank screen.
Confirm auth context loads without runtime errors.
Confirm protected admin pages are not visible to the wrong role.
Confirm admin-only pages are marked and grouped clearly.
Confirm hub pages behave correctly for protected access.
Confirm reporting/export pages behave correctly for protected access.
Confirm role-based sidebar/nav items match expected access.
Confirm no major console/runtime errors during normal navigation.
Run frontend build and backend typecheck/build after every role/security patch.
